n: Multi-channel power amplifier for commercial installations
d: Multi-channel power amplifier for commercial installations

specs.label: Frequency Response
specs.value: Filter-selectable, -3 dB (ref. 1 kHz, analog in to speaker out): HP 30/100/150 Hz to 20 kHz, LP 30 to 150 Hz (4/8 ohm); HP 50/100/150 Hz to 20 kHz, LP 50 to 150 Hz (70/100 V)

specs.label: Crosstalk between channels (dBA)
specs.value: < -70 dB (4 ohm) to < -95 dB (100 V), ref. 1 kHz, 12 dB below maximum

specs.label: Input Sensitivity
specs.value: +6 dBu (LEVEL 0 dB) / 0 dBu (LEVEL +6 dB); max input level +18 dBu

specs.label: Max. output Power/channel
specs.value: 500 W (4 ohm / 70 V), 600 W (8 ohm / 100 V) per channel, power sharing at minimum impedance

specs.label: Max. output voltage/channel
specs.value: 40.0 V RMS (4 ohm); 56.0 V RMS (8 ohm); 70.7 V RMS (70 V); 100 V RMS (100 V)

specs.label: Nominal Impedance
specs.value: 4 ohm; 8 ohm; 70 V; 100 V (selectable per channel)
